notes.title: Alpha Centauri Wars - Weekend event
notes.content:
Alpha Centauri Wars is coming back this weekend! This edition will use the regular ship tree.

Gem transfers are enabled, use [V] or gamepad LB to transfer gems. Meet dangerous yet generous aliens in the center of the map.

As in all ACW events, the seats in all regions are limited (especially in Europe and America). If you want to secure a seat, make sure to join in the first few minutes of the game.

[list]
[*] Asia: SATURDAY - November 16th, 2019 (9:00am CEST / GMT+1)
[*] Europe: SATURDAY - November 16th, 2019 (3:00pm CEST / GMT+1)
[*] America: SUNDAY - November 17th, 2019 (9:00pm CEST / GMT+1)
[/list]

Good luck Commanders!

ACW is a special event with 3 huge teams all competing in battle to be the final team standing. Three teams with more than 60 players in each team. More than two hundred players all at once. You do not want to miss these epic events! A link to enter the event for your time zone will show up on the main Starblast game menu at the time of the event.

notes.title: Alpha Centauri Wars - Weekend event
notes.content:
This new episode of the Alpha Centauri Wars series takes you to the Kappa* sector. Three factions will be taking part in the battle: NWAC, Halo Corsairs and UNGE.

Note that the Asia event is now moved to Saturday.

* Asia: SATURDAY - June 16th, 2018 ( 9:00am GMT+2 / 3:00am US-EDT / 2:00am US-CDT )

* Europe: SATURDAY - June 16th, 2018 ( 3:00pm GMT+2 / 9:00am US-EDT / 8:00am US-CDT )

* America: SUNDAY - June 17th, 2018 ( 9:00pm GMT+2 / 3:00pm US-EDT / 2:00pm US-CDT )

How to join: be ready a the time given and click Alpha Centauri Wars from the main menu.

Good luck Commanders!

*Note: Kappa is a letter of the Greek alphabet, following Iota.

One more note: exceptionally there will be no poster for this episode. Next poster... next episode.

notes.title: Update: 32bit Windows and windowed mode
notes.content:
We have updated the standalone and Steam client today:
[list]
  [*] Windows 32 bit systems are now supported
  [*] You can now switch between fullscreen or windowed mode using Alt+Enter
[/list]

Besides this, there has been a number of improvements and fixes to the core game since the launch on Steam:

2017-11-28
* Improved invasion mode rankings (now shows number of victories)

2017-11-27
* Battle Royale custom games

2017-11-21
* New: invasion mode leaderboard!
* Repulsive field improved (survival mode)
* changed condition for closing team mode games (time>15 min)

2017-11-20
* Increased radar range in invasion mode.

2017-11-16
* Fixed problem with explosion sounds
* Fixed bug with music volume in invasion mode
* Fixed RCS button bug on touch screens
* Added possibility to start invasion mode private games
* A bit more crystals and weapons in invasion waves 1 and 2
* Fixed countdown display in invasion mode wave zero
* Added volume sliders for music and sound fx in game settings

2017-11-14
* Invasion mode balance improvements
* Improved radar in invasion mode
* Fixed friendly collisions (all team modes)

2017-11-10
* Invasion mode balance update

Full updated changelog is always accessible here:
 [url=https://starblast.io/changelog.txt] starblast.io/changelog.txt [/url]
